title: Apex
description: Apex is a performance/VFX modpack for minecraft version 1.21.11 and up!
body:
![apex logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/96a34a3ec48770d47018f98ad51b3bee33057b65.png)
**a performance/VFX modpack for minecraft versions 1.21.11 and up!**
# types of mods included:
- quality of life mods
- VFX mods!
- and preformance mods!
works great on servers like **hypixel!** and **cubecraft**

join the apex community today!
